query:
SELECT 
  id,
  client_name,
  client_email,
  amount,
  due_date,
  payment_status,
  CASE
    WHEN payment_status IN ('paid', 'cancelled') THEN payment_status
    WHEN payment_status = 'pending' AND due_date < CURDATE() THEN 'overdue'
    ELSE 'pending'
  END AS effective_status,
  CURDATE() as hoje
FROM inspection_charges
WHERE payment_status = 'pending'
ORDER BY due_date ASC
LIMIT 20;
